sharedStreamClaim.note: Not measured here. The no-new-draw claim is the sp-equivalence fingerprint, which is exact where a probe would be indicative.

cost.note: this arm's own counters, for the record only. `programs` counts what this page has compiled so far, so it is NOT comparable across trees from here — the cross-tree reading is `costComparison`, taken by two `--mode cost` runs that are each the first arm of a fresh page.

particles.note: emission, not liveness: ParticleSystem has no live counter (`layers.*.live` is initialised at src/fx/ParticleSystem.js:141 and never written).

corpseDissolve.note: why the program count is allowed to move by one: `deathDissolve` compiles a dissolve material variant, and before this slice `resolveObject` could not see an enemy rig, so the call did nothing. Calls vs starts separates "asked" from "happened".
